manifest.name: @ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts
manifest.description: Unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired UI theme for DeepSeek Harness Web and the official desktop client

bundle.text:
# dsh-theme-prts — DeepSeek Harness Web client plugin patch layer.
- insert:
    - id: theme-prts
      name: '@ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts'

readme.text:
面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 和官方桌面客户端的个人、非商业明日方舟 / P.R.T.S. 同人 UI 插件。主题保留 Harness 的原生交互和数据流，将工作区、会话与对话组织成罗德岛设施终端。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 本项目是个人制作的非官方《明日方舟》同人主题，与上海鹰角网络科技有限公司及相关发行方不存在隶属、合作、授权或背书关系。
>
> MIT 许可证仅覆盖本项目原创代码。安装包中若干可识别的《明日方舟》名称、角色图像、徽记及其衍生素材不属于 MIT 授权范围，本项目不向使用者授予复制、修改、再分发、再许可或商业使用这些第三方素材的权利。
>
> 素材可从公开网页访问不代表获得再利用或再分发授权；免费、非商业使用也不当然构成授权。素材来源与许可边界详见 [第三方素材说明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.zh-CN.md)。
>
> 本项目及其发行包可能因权利人请求、平台政策或维护者决定，随时暂停发布、限制下载或移除相关素材，不保证持续提供。

主题安装后默认关闭，不会立即改变页面。
Baker 会话主题参考《明日方舟：终末地》的通讯界面。在主题设置「外观」中选择 Baker，点击用户或 AI 头像即可上传、裁剪或恢复默认。原图与裁剪位置保存在服务端，同一 DSH 实例内共享，之后可继续裁剪；支持拖动定位、滑块及滚轮／触摸板缩放。确认后保存，动图使用第一帧，单张最大 5 MB。

- **当前维护线仅声明支持 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`。** `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 同步限定为该版本，不承诺兼容其他版本或后续候选版。
- 验证以本地 `0.2.2-rc.1` Web 端为准，包含新版主面板、工作区和会话卡片、正文主题、Baker 头像、输入区、浮层、透明背景及移动端抽屉等已记录的检查；不等于对全部功能完成验收。同版本官方桌面客户端使用同一个主题包，但尚未完成实机验收，不沿用旧版桌面测试作为新版保证。
- 新版默认“收起后显示的回复 → 全部回复”：中间正文不会随工作步骤折叠，工具与推理等过程内容可折叠。改为“仅最终回答”时，中间正文仍会折叠；主题保留这两种模式，不修改宿主偏好。
- **旧版 DSH 请保留原有主题版本，或先升级 DSH 再更新主题。** 对 `0.2.1-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.3`、`0.2.1-rc.5`，最后包含这些版本支持声明的公开主题为 `@ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts@2.7.2`；当前维护线不再验证这些旧版本。代码中的旧 DOM 兜底和回归夹具不构成兼容承诺。
- 若仍使用 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`，请固定主题 `@ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts@1.4.2`；使用 DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` 时请固定 `1.0.2`，使用 DSH `0.1.2` 或 `0.1.5` 发布线时请固定 `0.1.102`。
主题设置通过 DSH 原生配置服务保存，同一 profile 下的在线页面会同步更新。首次接入时，仅当服务端尚未保存主题配置，才迁移当前浏览器的旧设置；已有服务端配置优先。保存冲突或失败会显示提示，不自动重传旧配置；“重试保存”会按当前版本重新提交失败的修改。部分旧版 DSH 的远程访问仅支持内存配置，此时会提示未保存，需要宿主提供持久化支持。升级后需重新加载主题服务端插件，才能注册新增配置。

Web 端与官方桌面客户端使用同一个主题包 `@ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts`，无需单独的桌面版主题。

以下为 Web 端的命令行安装方式，在已经可以正常运行 DSH Web 的环境中执行：

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add @ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts
```

安装或更新后建议重新启动所使用的 DSH Web 服务或官方桌面客户端，以确保主题被完整加载。然后进入“Settings → 插件 → P.R.T.S.”启用主题；完整外观设置位于主界面左上角的罗德岛徽记。

主题包已公开发布到 npm，无需 GitHub 登录或访问令牌。重新执行安装命令即可更新到 `latest`；如需锁定版本，可使用 `@ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts@<版本号>`。若命令提示 `pnpm not found`，请先安装 pnpm。

- P.R.T.S. / Rhodes Island / RIIC 设施化工作区、会话与对话界面；
- 与 Harness 同步的日间 / 夜间模式、三套外观预设和四档界面材质；
- 城市剪影、阵营粒子徽记、会话声纹和 P.R.T.S. 启动序列；
- 电脑、平板和手机屏幕布局，以及减少动效和降低透明度适配；
- PRTS 手形光标，支持按下、按住和松开效果（标准模式按点击目标的后代数量分档：≤128 保留完整动画，129～256 仅按下与恢复，>256 保持静态）；可点击区域使用 link 手形，调整大小使用四向静态光标；文本框和正文文字使用静态 I 形光标，可在主题设置的“光标模式”中选择系统光标；
- 无运行时网络请求、分析统计或额外遥测。
鼠标素材来自 [crowninggg/prts-cursor v1.1.4](https://github.com/crowninggg/prts-cursor/releases/tag/v1.1.4)，提取后适配为网页光标；来源、处理方式和许可边界见 [第三方素材说明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.zh-CN.md#prts-手形与文本光标)。
“Settings → 插件 → P.R.T.S.”提供主题总开关和启动动画开关。主界面左上角的罗德岛徽记提供完整外观设置，按外观、交互、会话流线、粒子效果四页切换。各页保留滚动位置；窄屏使用顶部分类栏，也支持方向键切换。

在“粒子效果 → 徽记管理”中，可分别设置新会话的单张徽记与正文的轮换列表。正文列表支持内置与自定义图案混排，每张可预览、上传替换或删除，长按徽记选项任意位置即可拖动排序，松开自动保存，Esc 取消，也可新增徽记（最多 12 张，至少保留 1 张）；新增和“预览 / 替换”使用独立编辑弹窗，桌面端左右布局、窄屏上下布局；拖动预览取景框中的图案调整裁剪位置，平移只改变点阵位置及可见范围，不重新排列粒子，也支持方向键微调和“居中”复位，缩放仍由滑块控制；取消或关闭时，未应用的修改会先询问是否放弃，关闭后返回原列表位置。两处均可独立恢复内置设置；存在自定义徽记时会先列出受影响的素材，提供逐张导出及恢复确认。未导出就恢复后，相关素材将无法从此处的设置中找回。上传 PNG、WebP 或 JPEG 后可调整轮廓提取、阈值、缩放及裁剪位置；“线稿轮廓”模式提取图像边缘，并按各档密度采样为点阵，阈值越高保留的细节越少。线稿模式下可选择“彩色图提轮廓”或“纯线稿提笔画”，点阵会自动细化；“去除碎线”独立控制孤立短线过滤，五官细节丢失时可降至 0。复杂人物图建议先简化背景和纹理。点击“应用到此处”后才会保存。正文沿用滚动触发的轮换、扰动与重组效果。图片上传到当前 DSH 实例，在独立后台线程处理；原图、参数、草稿和已应用配置保存在 `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-theme-prts/emblems`，不同工作区、会话及连接此实例的浏览器共享徽记设置。已应用图案可以重新打开继续调整，页面会自动同步。不会由主题插件发送给第三方图片服务。支持最大 8 MB、1600 万像素的图片，推荐透明底标志或黑白剪影。
自定义徽记可点击“导出素材”，下载单张 `.prts-emblem.json` 素材包，包含原图和调整参数。在另一套 DSH 的“新增徽记”或“预览 / 替换”中选择“导入徽记素材包”，预览确认后应用；导入后仍可继续编辑，不会自动覆盖首页徽记或正文列表。素材包上限 12 MB，导入时会按原参数重新生成粒子。

也可以在任意允许这些工具的 DSH 会话上传图片，说“帮我把这张图做成 PRTS 粒子徽记，先给我预览”。AI 生成或编辑的图片也可直接作为来源：先用 `read_image` 读取工作区中的图片，再调用 inspect 获取附件标识，无需下载后重新上传。接口识别当前会话上传及工具返回的图片，不接受任意附件标识；徽记工具自身返回的粒子预览不作为原图。AI 可调用 `prts_emblem_inspect`、`prts_emblem_preview` 和 `prts_emblem_apply`，使用 `mode: lineart` 生成线稿点阵（`lineSource: edges` 提取彩色图轮廓，`lineSource: ink` 提取纯线稿笔画，`cleanup: 0..12` 控制碎线过滤），或继续调整提取方式、阈值、缩放和裁剪，并按要求应用到新会话或正文轮换列表。生成预览不会改变已应用徽记，配置冲突会要求重新读取。预览图可在会话工具卡片中展示；使用支持图像输入的模型时，工具也会把预览图片交给模型分析。重画图案仍需要该会话另有图片编辑工具。保留最近约 200 份草稿，已应用徽记的编辑源不会被自动清理。服务端图片处理需要 Node.js 20.9 或更高版本。
主题不会主动改写第三方插件的菜单、弹窗和浮层样式。
若主题导致页面不可用，在 Harness 地址后添加 `?prts-safe=1`。安全模式会阻止所有主题视觉挂载，但保留“Settings → 插件 → P.R.T.S.”中的基础开关和恢复提示。在此页面关闭主题会保存到 DSH；清除浏览器缓存不会重置服务端设置。

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove @ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts
```

卸载后建议重新启动 DSH Web。主题偏好保存在 DSH 当前 profile 的原生配置中，浏览器只保留启动缓存。多个全局主题可能发生 CSS 冲突，建议一次只启用一个完整 UI 主题。

需要 Node.js 20.9 或更高版本（推荐与 DSH 一致使用 Node.js 24）：

```bash
npm ci
npm run check
```

版本变化见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)，维护者发布步骤见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)。

readme.section: 在 DSH 会话中设置 Baker 头像
readme.text:
可上传图片后对 AI 说：“把这张图设为我的 Baker 头像，裁剪到人物面部。”也可以让 AI 生成或编辑图片后直接设置。工具 `prts_avatar_inspect` 查看当前配置与会话图片；`prts_avatar_apply` 支持更换用户／AI 头像、基于已有原图重新裁剪和恢复默认。头像在当前 DSH 实例共享，保存替换后不保留旧原图；仅在 Baker 会话主题下显示，工具不会切换设备本地的主题选项。

Baker 的“合并过程回复头像”默认开启：每轮仅首条可见正文显示头像，最终回答不再单独保留。默认“全部回复”下，工具 / 推理折叠不触发头像重扫；“仅最终回答”等场景改变正文可见性时，头像跟随首条仍可见正文。用户输入或中途插话开启新一轮；关闭开关恢复逐条头像。此开关不改宿主的“全部回复 / 仅最终回答”偏好，也不改变气泡对齐。

在主题设置的“会话外观 → 会话背景”中，可选择默认背景、分区背景或完整背景。分区模式分别设置左侧边栏与会话正文；只有正文图片时，左侧边栏使用半透明材质显示其下方的背景；左侧边栏有独立图片时，仍显示自己的图片。右侧边栏在正文或完整背景上也使用半透明材质。完整模式以同一张图片贯穿各区域。图片居中铺满，可调节背景遮罩提高文字可读性；分区模式下正文图片固定在主框架坐标上，侧栏展开时不重新缩放图片。切换模式或恢复默认设置不会删除图片，点击“移除图片”才会删除对应素材。

非会话页面（插件、插件市场、设置、自动化任务等）在分区正文图片或完整背景启用时继续透出壁纸，页面基础背景保持透明；仅增加一个完全透明、不接收点击的背景板，默认模糊 8px，不额外铺实色底或遮罩。关闭玻璃、系统请求减少透明度或浏览器不支持背景模糊时，不强制改成不透明画布。卡片与第三方自定义材质不额外改写；会话及侧栏材质不变。
支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP、AVIF，单张不超过 10 MB、4000 万像素。服务端自动转为 WebP 并限制在 3840×2160 内，保存在 `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-theme-prts/backgrounds`。替换或移除后清理旧图片，不保留历史原图。模式和遮罩通过 DSH 原生配置同步，图片在当前实例共享。

自定义背景下，可分别调整左侧边栏、右侧边栏、设置侧栏、Baker 气泡和经典主题用户消息的材质透明度，默认值依次为 94%、94%、70%、50%、50%（数值越高越透明）。左侧边栏与右侧边栏的透明度和模糊度可独立设置；旧配置没有右侧边栏数值时，初始沿用左侧边栏数值。圆环支持鼠标或触屏拖动、方向键微调与直接输入百分比；拖动时本地预览，松手保存，Esc 或指针取消时回退。对应图片启用后，还可用滑杆调整模糊度（0–32px，默认依次为 8、8、12、8、8px），调节时预览，松手后保存。透明度和模糊度均可单独恢复默认；纯色背景不显示模糊度调节。右侧边栏材质需要启用正文或完整背景；设置侧栏材质需要启用左侧边栏或完整背景；消息材质需要启用正文或完整背景，并在相应会话主题下生效。

“会话主题”和“会话背景”分为独立设置页。输入框增强毛玻璃位于背景页：默认背景下可以开关，分区或完整背景下始终开启，切回默认背景时恢复原有开关选择。Baker 可开启“回复完成前显示加载动画”（默认关闭），每轮正在生成的正文暂以三点明暗动画代替，完成或中断后显示收到的正文；经典主题、思考过程与工具卡片不受此开关影响。

背景图片可设置独立的保护区域：点击「保护重要区域」，在弹窗中拖动默认保护框移动或拖动四边或四角缩放，原图边缘显示百分比坐标尺。侧栏按当前高度并排预览较窄／较宽侧栏，正文与完整背景并排预览横向／纵向窗口，实时显示裁剪效果，无法保留完整区域时仅在设置中提示。保存后保持居中铺满，仅在必要时最小幅度移动图片以保住保护框；框无法完整容纳时，横向优先保留中心、纵向优先保留顶端，并限制偏移以避免露底。清除保护区域后恢复居中裁剪；替换图片会清除旧框。保护区域随图片在当前实例同步，并包含在完整主题导入导出中。

背景、头像和徽记图片、徽记素材包以及主题文件均支持拖拽到对应上传区域，一次添加一个文件，沿用各入口的类型和大小限制。替换已有背景时，会先在主题弹窗中显示新旧图片，确认后保存。

readme.section: 在 DSH 会话中设置背景
readme.text: 可以说：“把这张图设为完整背景，保护右侧人物，背景再淡一点。”也可以让 AI 生成图片，或通过会话已有的搜索、下载工具找图；生成或下载到工作区后，先用 `read_image` 读取，再调用 `prts_background_inspect` 获取附件标识，无需用户重新上传。工具直接返回的图片附件也可使用。背景工具本身不提供搜索、生成或 URL 下载能力。

readme.section: 在 DSH 会话中设置背景
readme.text:
- `prts_background_inspect`：查看三处素材、尺寸、保护区域、图片版本，以及当前 profile 的背景模式、遮罩、五个区域的材质、会话风格和设置版本，列出当前会话可用图片。
- `prts_background_apply`：替换、移除图片，或设置、清除保护区域。使用图片 `revision`；保护区域为按 EXIF 转正后图片的归一化矩形 `x/y/width/height`。替换时默认清除旧保护框，也可同时指定新框。
- `prts_background_configure`：设置 `off/split/full` 模式和 `0..0.9` 遮罩（越高越淡）。可通过 `material.blur`（0..32 整数像素）和 `material.opacity`（0..1 底色不透明度，越高越不透明）调整材质；区域为 `sidebar` 左侧边栏、`rightSidebar` 右侧边栏、`rail` 设置侧栏、`baker` Baker 气泡、`classicUser` 经典用户消息。后两者仅在对应会话风格且存在完整背景或分区正文图片时生效；保存参数不会自动切换风格或启用图片。使用 `settings.revision`，只更新指定字段，同步到当前 profile 的在线页面。

readme.section: 在 DSH 会话中设置背景
readme.text: 保存素材与启用模式分为两步，AI 应检查返回的 `activeSlots`，必要时启用相应模式；不会自动打开主题总开关。图片限制和共享范围与手动设置一致，替换/删除不保留旧原图，切回默认背景不删除素材。版本冲突需要重新读取核对；受“允许 AI 定制主题”开关统一控制。

点击主题设置底部、与「恢复默认」并列的「导入与导出」，在弹窗中下载 `.prts-theme.json` 文件。「包含自定义素材」默认勾选：包含全部主题设置，以及当前已配置的背景图片、用户／AI 头像、首页与正文徽记及排列。头像保留原图和裁剪参数，徽记保留原图和编辑参数，背景保存当前使用的 WebP 图片；历史素材和临时草稿不包含在内。取消勾选则仅导出设置。

导入时先读取文件并显示摘要，确认后保存到当前 DSH 实例。仅配置文件保留目标端现有素材；完整文件替换素材及徽记排列，空素材项恢复默认。旧文件缺少的设置保留当前值；遇到当前版本不认识的配置字段时，确认前会列出导入后无法保留的字段；不支持的文件版本会提示更新。文件最大 160 MB，不包含会话、账户或连接凭据。

读取文件、导出、导入及恢复时会显示阶段进度。读取和导出可中途取消；导入或恢复取消后，会等待当前写入确认并尝试回退已写入素材。最终保存与回退阶段不可取消。导入、导出分块在对应操作期间保持高亮。
每次导入前会发起当前配置备份下载，请确认保存。当前页面也可点击「恢复导入前配置」，恢复最近一次导入前的状态；刷新后请使用下载的备份文件。保存失败会尝试回退已确认写入的素材；若连接中断或其他页面并发修改导致无法完整恢复，会显示错误，可在确认当前状态后重新导入备份。

readme.section: 在 DSH 会话中导入、导出主题
readme.text:
- 对 AI 说“导出当前主题，包含素材”，使用 `prts_theme_export` 返回可下载的 `.prts-theme.json` 附件。指定 `includeAssets: false` 可仅导出设置。
- 上传主题文件，或使用本会话工具已经返回的文件附件，调用 `prts_theme_import_preview` 查看摘要、配置变化、素材覆盖范围及会丢失的未知字段。未指定附件时可列出会话中的 JSON 文件。
- 用户授权导入后，使用返回的 `previewId` 调用 `prts_theme_import`。预检仅限当前会话，有效期 15 分钟；文件、设置或相关素材发生变化后需要重新预检。导入前先保存备份附件，备份失败则不修改主题。导入失败或取消时尝试回退已确认写入的素材，并返回错误及备份；并发修改可能使回退不完整，需核对实际状态。

readme.section: 在 DSH 会话中导入、导出主题
readme.text: AI 工具与设置界面的文件完全互通，均支持仅配置和包含素材两种文件，上限 160 MB。完整文件包含背景保护区域、头像原图及裁剪参数、徽记源图及排列。仅配置导入保留当前素材，旧文件缺少的设置保留当前值。设置影响当前 profile，素材影响同一实例；导入可能关闭主题或 AI 工具，预检时应核对这些变化。导出文件和导入前备份均可再次预检、导入。

readme.section: AI 工具状态、图片来源与视觉预览
readme.text:
`prts_theme_status` 为始终可用的只读入口，仅返回“允许 AI 定制主题”的开关状态和手动开启位置，不读取素材或配置内容。关闭开关后会移除 12 个定制工具，只保留状态入口；AI 应先提醒用户在“罗德岛徽记 → AI 工具”手动开启，不自行打开开关，也不通过 shell、HTTP 或文件编辑绕过。定制工具执行入口会再次检查状态，拒绝关闭后遗留的工具调用。该提示用于引导 AI 行为，不是对会话其他通用工具的权限隔离。

图片列表按最近在会话中出现的顺序排列，提供 `lastSeenOrder`、有可靠事件时间时的 `lastSeenAt`，以及同名图片的 `latestForName` 标记；“最近”不是文件修改时间，重新读取旧图会更新其出现顺序。

readme.section: AI 工具状态、图片来源与视觉预览
readme.text:
`prts_background_preview` 可预览会话候选图（attachmentId）或已保存背景（slot），不修改主题。默认使用当前遮罩，同时生成日间与夜间预览，因为服务端不知道用户页面的当前日夜模式。可临时指定 dim、scheme、预览宽高和保护区域；默认完整/正文预览 1280×720，侧栏 360×900，宽高均限制 64～1920。候选图先经过与实际保存相同的转正、缩放和 WebP 转换，再模拟铺满裁剪与 sRGB 遮罩；裁剪按源图像素取整。返回可下载图片附件，支持视觉的模型另获图片内容。这是背景层合成，不包含文字、消息泡、侧栏毛玻璃，不等同于真实页面截图。预览工具返回的图片不作为来源列表中的原图。

完整主题导入会删除被替换的旧背景 WebP，头像替换也不保留旧原图；导入前备份包含恢复所需数据。每个自定义徽记会生成新的草稿和预览，相同源图按内容哈希复用；达到约 200 份草稿时按创建时间清理较旧且未受保护的草稿，正在应用的徽记受保护。反复完整导入会增加草稿；预检的 effects 字段会列出这些副作用。

readme.section: AI 工具状态、图片来源与视觉预览
readme.text: 宿主提供运行上下文接口时，主题还会在每轮模型请求中主动提供当前开关状态和以上操作要求，减少 AI 在工具关闭时自行寻找绕行方案。

**“PRTS 跟随光标（实验）”因实机测试表现不佳，现暂时停用。** 主题设置的交互设置中，光标模式仅保留“系统光标”和“PRTS 原生光标”。跟随光标实现代码保留；已保存或导入的跟随光标配置会按 PRTS 原生光标运行，不修改其他配色或外观设置。首次安装默认使用 PRTS 原生光标。

从主题 `2.6.1` 升级至 `2.7.0` 时，实验性跟随光标会自动回退为 PRTS 原生光标，无需手动修改配置；系统光标与 PRTS 原生光标不受影响。加载旧配置本身不会将回退结果写回服务端。若必须继续使用跟随光标，请保留主题 `2.6.1` 及其支持的 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.3` 或 `0.2.1-rc.5` 组合；主题 `2.6.1` 不声明支持 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`。

> This is an unofficial, personal Arknights fan theme. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, authorized by, or endorsed by Shanghai Hypergryph Network Technology Co., Ltd. or any regional publisher.
>

Certain recognizable Arknights names, character images, emblems, and derivative material included in the package are outside the MIT grant. This project grants users no right to copy, modify, redistribute, sublicense, or commercially use that third-party material.
>
> Public availability of source material does not itself grant permission to reuse or redistribute it, and free or non-commercial use is not automatically authorized. See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for provenance and licensing boundaries.
>
> This project and its release packages may be suspended, restricted, or have relevant material removed at any time in response to a rights-holder request, platform policy, or maintainer decision. Continued availability is not guaranteed.

The Baker conversation theme is inspired by the messenger in Arknights: Endfield. Select Baker under Appearance, then click either avatar to upload, crop, or restore its default. Original images and crop positions are stored on the server and shared within the same DSH instance, allowing later re-cropping. Drag to reposition and use the slider, mouse wheel, or trackpad to zoom. Changes apply after confirmation. Animated images use the first frame; each upload is limited to 5 MB.

- **The current maintenance line declares support only for DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`.** `engines.dsh` in `package.json` is restricted to that exact version. Other versions, including later release candidates, are not covered.
- Verification targets the local `0.2.2-rc.1` Web deployment, with recorded checks for the new main panel, workspace and session cards, message styling, Baker avatars, composer, overlays, transparent backgrounds, and mobile drawers. This is not exhaustive acceptance testing. The official desktop client uses the same theme package, but that version has not received real-device desktop verification; older desktop results are not a guarantee for the new version.
- The host defaults to “Replies After Collapse → All replies”: intermediate reply bodies remain visible while tool, reasoning, and other process content can fold. “Final answer only” still folds intermediate replies. The theme handles both modes without changing the host preference.
- **For older DSH versions, keep your existing theme version or upgrade DSH before updating the theme.** For `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, and `0.2.1-rc.5`, the last public theme release declaring support is `@ash-qw/dsh-the

Web and the official desktop client use the same theme package, `@ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts`; no separate desktop edition is needed.

For Web command-line installation, run the following in an environment where DSH Web already runs normally:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add @ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts
```

Restarting your DSH Web service or official desktop client after installation or update is recommended to ensure the theme is fully loaded. Then enable it under “Settings → Plugins → P.R.T.S.” The Rhodes Island emblem at the upper left of the main interface opens the complete appearance controls.

The theme is published publicly on npm and requires no GitHub login or access token. Run the install command again to update to `latest`; to pin a release, use `@ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts@<version>`. If the command reports `pnpm not found`, install pnpm first.

Cursor artwork comes from [crowninggg/prts-cursor v1.1.4](https://github.com/crowninggg/prts-cursor/releases/tag/v1.1.4), extracted and adapted for web cursors. See [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md#prts-hand-and-text-cursors) for provenance, adaptations, and licensing boundaries.

“Settings → Plugins → P.R.T.S.” provides the theme and startup-animation switches. The Rhodes Island emblem at the upper left of the main interface provides presets, environment texture, particle marks, interface material, navigation, and accessibility controls.

The appearance panel has four pages: Appearance, Interaction, Session Flow, and Particle Effects. Switching pages preserves each page’s scroll position. On narrow screens, tabs appear above the content; arrow keys also switch pages.

Under Particle Effects → Emblem Management, configure the new-session emblem independently from the conversation rotation list. Mix built-in and uploaded images in the list, preview or replace individual entries, add or remove entries (1–12). Long-press anywhere on an emblem card to drag it into a new position; release to save or press Escape to cancel. Keyboard users can press Space on the thumbnail, use arrow keys to reorder, and press Enter to save. Adding or editing an emblem opens a separate modal with a side-by-side desktop layout and a stacked narrow-screen layout. Drag the pattern within the preview frame to position the crop; translation changes only particle positions and visibility, preserving the dot pattern. Arrow keys provide fine adjustments, Center resets the position, and the zoom slider controls scale. Closing prompts before discarding unapplied edits and returns to the original list position. Each area can be restored independently. If it contains custom emblems, restoration first lists the affected assets with individual export buttons and requires explicit confirmation. Export and save the files before restoring; otherwise those assets cannot be recovered from

Click Export Asset on a custom emblem to download a single `.prts-emblem.json` package containing its source image and editing parameters. In another DSH instance, choose Add Emblem or Preview / Replace, then import the package and review it before applying. Imported emblems remain editable; importing does not automatically overwrite the hero or rotation list. Packages are limited to 12 MB; particles are rebuilt from the original parameters on import.

In any DSH session where the tools are allowed, upload an image and ask the AI to preview it as a PRTS particle emblem. `prts_emblem_inspect`, `prts_emblem_preview`, and `prts_emblem_apply` let the AI adjust extraction, threshold, scale, and crop, then apply a draft to the new-session emblem or conversation rotation list. Images generated or edited by AI can also be used: read the workspace image with `read_image`, then call inspect to obtain its attachment ID, without asking the user to reupload it. Only images uploaded or returned by tools in the current session are accepted; particle previews returned by the emblem tool are excluded as sources. Use `mode: lineart` for outline dot art, `lineSource: edges` for color-image contours or `lineSource: ink` for existing ink strokes, and `cleanup: 0..12` for isolated-stroke filtering. Previews do not change applied settings; conflicting writes require a fresh read. Previews appear in native chat tool cards; image-capable models also receive the preview as image input. Redrawing still requires an image-editing tool in that session. Around 200 recent drafts are retained, while editing sources for applied emblems are protected. Server-side
The theme does not proactively restyle menus, dialogs, or overlays created by third-party plugins.

Append `?prts-safe=1` to block all visual mounts while retaining the basic switches and recovery note under “Settings → Plugins → P.R.T.S.” Deleting `dsh.ui.prts.v1` returns the next load to the default disabled state.

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove @ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts
```

Restarting DSH Web after removal is recommended. Browser theme preferences are retained. Avoid enabling multiple full-page themes at once because their CSS may conflict.

Node.js 20.9 or newer is required (Node.js 24 is recommended, matching DSH):

```bash
npm ci
npm run check
```

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for release history and [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md) for maintainer release instructions.

readme.section: Set Baker avatars from a DSH conversation
readme.text: Upload an image and ask the AI to set it as your Baker avatar, or have it generate/edit an image first. `prts_avatar_inspect` reads current configuration and conversation images; `prts_avatar_apply` replaces user/AI avatars, re-crops the current original, or restores defaults. Changes are shared within the DSH instance. Replacing an avatar discards its previous original. Avatars appear in Baker mode; tools do not change the device-local conversation theme.

readme.section: Set Baker avatars from a DSH conversation
readme.text: Baker’s “Group process reply avatars” option is enabled by default. Only the first visible body in each reply turn shows an avatar; final answers no longer keep a separate avatar. With the default “All replies” preference, folding tools or reasoning does not rescan avatar groups. When reply visibility changes, as in “Final answer only”, the avatar follows the first remaining visible body. User input or steering starts a new group; disabling the option restores individual avatars. Host “All replies / Final answer only” preferences and bubble alignment remain unchanged.

readme.section: Set Baker avatars from a DSH conversation
readme.text: Theme preferences now use DSH native profile configuration. Connected pages share updates; browser storage is only a startup cache. Existing local preferences are migrated only when the Host has no saved theme configuration. Failed or conflicting writes require an explicit retry and never automatically overwrite Host values. Older DSH hosts may expose memory-only settings for remote access; these cannot be reported as durable saves. Reload the server-side plugin after upgrading to register its configuration schema. Avatar and emblem assets keep their existing server storage.

Under Appearance → Conversation background, choose the default surface, separate left sidebar/content images, or a single full background. In split mode, a content image is anchored to the stable frame, so opening the sidebar does not rescale it. Without a separate left sidebar image, translucent material reveals the content image; a configured left sidebar image still appears on its own. The right sidebar also uses translucent material over a content or full background. Images use centered cover sizing with an adjustable readability mask. Switching modes retains images; removal deletes the selected asset. PNG, JPEG, WebP and AVIF uploads are limited to 10 MB and 40 million pixels, converted to WebP within 3840×2160, and stored in `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-theme-prts/backgrounds`. Replacements delete obsolete files. Mode and mask settings use native DSH configuration; assets are shared within the instance.

With custom backgrounds, material transparency is independently adjustable for the left sidebar, right sidebar, settings rail, Baker bubbles, and Classic user messages (defaults: 94%, 94%, 70%, 50%, 50%; higher values are more transparent). The left and right sidebar settings are independent; older configurations without right sidebar values initially inherit the left values. Dials support mouse/touch dragging, arrow keys and exact percentage entry. Dragging previews locally; release saves, while Escape or pointer cancellation restores the saved value. When the matching image is active, a slider also adjusts blur from 0–32px (defaults: 8, 8, 12, 8, and 8px), previews changes immediately, and saves on release. Transparency and blur each have their own reset; blur controls stay hidden with solid backgrounds. Right sidebar glass requires a conversation or full background; settings rail glass requires a left sidebar or full background; message glass requires a conversation or full background and its matching conversation theme.

Non-conversation pages (plugins, marketplaces, settings and scheduled tasks) continue to reveal the active conversation or full wallpaper. Their base background stays transparent; one transparent, noninteractive background plate adds a default 8px blur without an extra solid fill or tint. Glass off, reduced-transparency preferences or missing backdrop-filter support do not force an opaque canvas. Existing card and third-party custom materials are left unchanged, as are conversation and sidebar materials.

Conversation theme and background use separate settings pages. Enhanced composer glass lives on the background page: optional with the default background and always active in split/full modes, preserving the previous default-mode choice. Baker's optional loading animation (off by default) replaces each streaming response body with three pulsing square dots until it settles or is interrupted. Classic messages, reasoning and tool cards remain unaffected.

Each background can have its own protected region. Open the modal editor from the image preview and drag the default box to move it, or drag its edges and corners to resize; percentage rulers are shown along the image edges. Sidebar previews compare narrow and wide tracks at the current sidebar height; conversation and full backgrounds use side-by-side landscape and portrait previews to show the crop; a notice appears only in settings when the entire region cannot fit. After saving, cover sizing stays centered unless a minimal shift is needed to keep the region visible. Oversized regions prioritize their horizontal center and vertical top, with offsets clamped to avoid empty edges. Clearing the region restores centered cropping; replacing the image clears the old region. Regions sync with images across the instance and are included in full theme exports and imports.

Background, avatar and emblem images, emblem bundles, and theme files can be dropped onto their respective upload areas. Add one file at a time; each area retains its existing type and size limits. Replacing a background opens a themed confirmation dialog showing the current and replacement images before saving.

Click **导入与导出** beside Restore defaults at the bottom of theme settings to open the transfer dialog to download a `.prts-theme.json` file. **包含自定义素材** is checked by default and includes all theme preferences, configured backgrounds, user/AI avatars, and the hero/conversation emblem selection and order. Avatars retain original images and crop parameters; emblems retain original images and editing parameters. Backgrounds use their stored WebP images. Historical assets and temporary drafts are excluded. Uncheck the option to export preferences only.

Import displays a summary before confirmation. Preferences-only files preserve destination assets; complete files replace assets and emblem order, with empty slots restoring defaults. Settings absent from older files retain their current values. Before confirmation, the importer lists fields it does not recognize and cannot preserve. Unsupported versions are rejected. The maximum file size is 160 MB. Chat data, accounts and connection credentials are not included.

Reading, exporting, importing and restoring show progress by stage. Reading and exporting can be cancelled. Cancelling an import or restore waits for the current write to settle, then attempts to roll back written assets. Cancellation is unavailable during final saving and rollback. The import or export section stays highlighted while its operation is active.

A backup download starts before each import. Keep that file for recovery after a refresh, or use **恢复导入前配置** in the current page to restore the state before the latest import. Failed imports attempt to roll back confirmed asset writes. Connection loss or concurrent edits can prevent full recovery; the UI reports failures so the saved backup can be imported after checking the current state.

readme.section: Set backgrounds from a DSH conversation
readme.text: Ask the AI to use an uploaded picture, generate one, or find and download one with the tools available in that conversation. For locally generated/downloaded images, use `read_image` first, then `prts_background_inspect` to obtain the attachment ID. Images returned directly by conversation tools also work; no manual re-upload is needed. These background tools do not themselves search, generate, or fetch URLs.

readme.section: Set backgrounds from a DSH conversation
readme.text:
- `prts_background_inspect`: inspect images, dimensions, protected regions, image revision, current profile settings/revision, and available conversation attachments.
- `prts_background_apply`: replace/remove a full, sidebar, or conversation image, or change its protected region. Use the image revision. Region coordinates are normalized to the EXIF-oriented image; replacing clears the old region unless a new one is supplied.
- `prts_background_configure`: update only the specified mode (`off/split/full`) and dimming (`0..0.9`, higher means more faded), using `settings.revision`. Optional `material.blur` (integer pixels, 0..32) and `material.opacity` (0..1, higher means more opaque) support `sidebar`, `rightSidebar`, `rail` (settings rail), `baker` (Baker bubbles), and `classicUser` (classic user messages). Inspect returns these values and the conversation style. Bubble materials require the matching conversation style and a full or conversation wallpaper; saving values does not activate either. Only supplied fields change; invalid values are rejected.

readme.section: Set backgrounds from a DSH conversation
readme.text: Saving an image and enabling its mode are separate steps; check the returned `activeSlots`. The theme master switch is never enabled automatically. Images are instance-wide; mode and dimming sync within the profile. Existing format/size limits apply. Replacing/removing deletes the old image, whereas switching to the default background retains assets. Conflicts require a fresh inspection. All three tools follow the existing AI customization switch.

readme.section: Import and export themes from a conversation
readme.text: `prts_theme_export` returns a downloadable `.prts-theme.json` attachment, including assets by default (`includeAssets: false` exports settings only). Upload a theme file or use a file attachment returned by a tool in the same conversation, then call `prts_theme_import_preview` to see the summary, settings changes, replacement scope, and ignored fields. Without an attachment ID, it lists JSON files in that conversation.

readme.section: Import and export themes from a conversation
readme.text: After the user authorizes importing, call `prts_theme_import` with the preview ID. Previews expire after 15 minutes, are conversation-specific, and become stale when settings or relevant assets change. A backup attachment must be saved before any changes. Failed or cancelled imports attempt to roll back confirmed asset writes and return the error and backup; concurrent edits can prevent complete recovery.

readme.section: Import and export themes from a conversation
readme.text: Files interoperate with the settings UI, with the same 160 MB limit. Full exports include background protected regions, avatar originals/crops, and emblem sources/order. Settings-only imports retain assets, and missing older settings retain current values. Settings affect the profile; assets affect the instance. Imported settings can disable the theme or AI tools, so review the preview. Export and backup attachments can be imported again.

readme.section: Tool status and background visual previews
readme.text: `prts_theme_status` remains available when AI customization is off. It reports only the switch status and manual activation instructions. The 12 customization tools are removed while disabled; agents are instructed to ask the user to enable the switch under the Rhodes Island emblem → AI tools, rather than enable it themselves or bypass it with shell, HTTP, or file edits. Execution guards reject stale customization calls after disabling. This guides agent behavior; it does not sandbox other general-purpose tools in the conversation.

readme.section: Tool status and background visual previews
readme.text: Image lists now sort by last appearance, expose `lastSeenOrder`, event-backed `lastSeenAt` when available, and `latestForName`. These describe conversation appearances, not filesystem modification times.

readme.section: Tool status and background visual previews
readme.text: `prts_background_preview` previews either an attachment or a saved background without applying it. It defaults to the current dimming and both light/dark schemes, since the server cannot infer the active browser scheme. Width/height, dimming, scheme, and protected region can be overridden. Candidate images use the same orientation, resizing, and WebP pipeline as saving. Outputs simulate cover cropping and sRGB dimming, with crop coordinates rounded to source pixels; they exclude text, bubbles, and glass materials and are not live screenshots. PNG file attachments are returned, with image content also supplied to vision-capable models. Preview receipts are excluded from source image discovery.

readme.section: Tool status and background visual previews
readme.text: Full imports delete replaced background WebP files and replace avatar originals; backups contain recovery data. Each custom emblem creates a new draft/preview, while identical source bytes share content-addressed storage. At roughly 200 drafts, older unprotected drafts are pruned; applied emblems remain protected. Repeated full imports grow the draft count. Import previews report these effects explicitly.

readme.section: Tool status and background visual previews
readme.text: When the host exposes runtime context registration, each model request also receives the current switch state and these handling instructions proactively.

**PRTS Follow cursor (experimental) is temporarily disabled because it performed poorly in real-device testing.** Interaction settings now offer only System cursor and PRTS Native cursor. The follow cursor implementation is retained. Saved or imported follow cursor preferences run as PRTS Native cursor without changing other colors or appearance settings. New installations default to PRTS Native cursor.

Upgrading the theme from `2.6.1` to `2.7.0` automatically falls back from the experimental follow cursor to PRTS Native cursor without manual configuration changes. System cursor and PRTS Native cursor are unaffected. Loading an old preference alone does not write the fallback back to the server. If the follow cursor is required, keep theme `2.6.1` paired with one of its supported DSH versions: `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, or `0.2.1-rc.5`. Theme `2.6.1` does not declare support for DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`.
